keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match (Querétaro).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match (Querétaro).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Querétaro 0, Puebla 1. Kevin Velasco (Puebla) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Omar Moreno with a cross.
Goal! Querétaro 0, Puebla 2. Omar Moreno (Puebla) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Kevin Velasco.
Óscar Villa (Puebla) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Querétaro. Carlos Villanueva replaces Bayron Duarte.
Second Half begins Querétaro 0, Puebla 2.
Substitution, Querétaro. Jesús Arellano replaces Carlo García.
Substitution, Querétaro. Enzo Giménez replaces Denilson Muñoz.
Substitution, Puebla. Fernando Monárrez replaces Omar Moreno.
Substitution, Puebla. Eduardo Mustre replaces Luifer Hernández.
Iker Moreno (Puebla) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Alí Ávila (Querétaro) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Ricardo Gutiérrez (Puebla).
Substitution, Querétaro. Paulo Victor replaces Daniel Parra.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Puebla. José Pachuca replaces Iker Moreno.
Eduardo Pérez (Querétaro) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Querétaro. Álex Alcalá replaces Iker Benito.
Substitution, Puebla. Alonso Ramírez replaces Alejandro Organista.
Substitution, Puebla. Carlos Baltazar replaces Mathías Tomás.
Alonso Ramírez (Puebla) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Santiago Homenchenko (Querétaro) is shown the yellow card.
